```python
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

@dataclass
class PersonalData:
    full_name: str
    birth_name: str
    birth_place: str
    birth_date: str
    mother_name: str
    citizenship: str
    address: str
    dap_id: str
    personal_id: str
    id_card_number: str
    address_card_number: str
    taj_number: str
    tax_id: str

@dataclass
class NameChangeApplication:
    applicant: PersonalData
    target_surname: str
    target_given_name: str
    target_full_name: str
    reason: str
    authority_name: str
    submission_location: str
    fee_huf: int
    application_date: str

def generate_application(data: PersonalData, new_given_name: str) -> NameChangeApplication:
    target_surname = data.birth_name.split()[0]
    target_full = f"{target_surname} {new_given_name.upper()}"
    return NameChangeApplication(
        applicant=data,
        target_surname=target_surname,
        target_given_name=new_given_name.upper(),
        target_full_name=target_full,
        reason=f"Kérem a hatóságot születési utónevem {data.birth_name.split()[-1]}-ról {new_given_name}-re történő módosításának engedélyezésére.",
        authority_name="Budapest Főváros Kormányhivatala Állampolgársági és Anyakönyvi Főosztály",
        submission_location="Szegedi Polgármesteri Hivatal Anyakönyvi Osztály / Bármely Kormányablak",
        fee_huf=13000,
        application_date=str(date.today())
    )

def export_json(application: NameChangeApplication, filepath: str) -> None:
    with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(asdict(application), f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

def main() -> None:
    applicant_data = PersonalData(
        full_name="MANCZ ZOLTÁN",
        birth_name="MANCZ ZOLTÁN",
        birth_place="MAGYARORSZÁG, KECSKEMÉT",
        birth_date="2003. 11. 14.",
        mother_name="VÖRÖS ILDIKÓ",
        citizenship="MAGYARORSZÁG",
        address="6724 Szeged, Bakay Nándor utca 24. E ép. 1 em. 15. ajtó",
        dap_id="927934620",
        personal_id="3-031114-4486",
        id_card_number="766514TE",
        address_card_number="282877LV",
        taj_number="121 408 138",
        tax_id="8499900356"
    )
    application = generate_application(applicant_data, "Bibi")
    export_json(application, "name_change_application.json")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
